resources.string: The weekly average shows how many dreams you typically record per week over a given time period. Comparing the overall average with the averages from the last 7 days lets you see whether your dream-recording frequency has changed recently.

The weekly average shows how many dreams you typically record per week over a given time period. Comparing the overall average with the averages from the last 7 days, and 30 days lets you see whether your dream-recording frequency has changed recently.

The weekly average shows how many dreams you typically record per week over a given time period. Comparing the overall average with the averages from the last 7 days, 30 days, and 6 months lets you see whether your dream-recording frequency has changed recently.
This chart shows on which days of the week you tend to record your dreams. See how your dream journaling habits are distributed throughout the week.

This statistic shows how consistently you record your dreams on consecutive days. It displays both your current streak and your longest streak, helping you see your recording habits and consistency over time.
